actions.text: Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 119-247.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Affects living and former participants of secrecy oath programs, particularly those from the Edgewood Arsenal program between 1948 and 1975.
dimensions.evidence: veterans who participated in the secrecy oath program at Edgewood Arsenal at Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland... beginning on January 1, 1948

dimensions.assessment: Substantially alters disability compensation awards by adjusting effective dates to the day following discharge or release for covered participants.
dimensions.evidence: The effective date of an award of disability compensation to a veteran... shall be the day following the date of the veteran's discharge or release.

dimensions.assessment: Implies increased federal outlays through retroactive disability compensation awards dating back to military discharge.
Amends title 38 to define secrecy oath programs, impose mandatory notification timelines on the Secretary of Veterans Affairs, and alter award effective dates.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 38, United States Code, to ensure veterans of secrecy oath programs receive the full benefits they have earned

dimensions.assessment: Combines immediate one-time notification deadlines with permanent changes to award effective date rules.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 90 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall-- identify the veterans...

missing_information: Total number of veterans who participated in secrecy oath programs outside of Edgewood Arsenal.
Total retroactive financial cost of adjusting disability compensation effective dates.
importance_detail.rationale: Mandates notification of benefits and retroactive disability compensation effective dates for veterans who participated in secrecy oath programs, specifically highlighting the Edgewood Arsenal program.
